name: mcp-zebra
description: MCP server exposing barcode tools (GTIN validation, GTIN generation, barcode decoding, barcode image generation), deployed as an AWS Lambda behind API Gateway.

scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p build && cd dist && zip -q -r ../build/lambda.zip index.js index.js.map zxing_full.wasm
scripts.tf:plan: npm run package && cd terraform && terraform plan
scripts.tf:apply: npm run package && cd terraform && terraform apply
